body: BLOCK exact 05e0746d65ea27db72d659d50616f006630c9df3 on two joined-authority gaps; all prior P/F, row-membership, revisit, disclosure, non-finite, accessibility, and independent-outcome repairs stand. BLOCKER 1: lines 73-79 say every accepted value already passed its construction boundary, and lines 271-297 treat CostBreakdown support, missing, imputed, reduction, and exclusion fields as published checked facts. Current source disproves that premise. CostBreakdown and its nested reduction records remain private[align] case classes with public Mirror.ProductOf reconstruction; live bead bd-01M17ZNXY6AS1CMBQJRH3JMNVX demonstrates an external-package CostBreakdown with supportWeight 5, total -7, present-and-missing Semantic, and an unpriced illegal imputation. HsmmResult.validated checks gate admission and only cost exclusion/mode coherence; it does not rerun AlignWire.costBreakdown or prove that nested receipts crossed that door. Such a forged record can therefore inhabit a gated HsmmResult and pass this courts stated input boundary. Required repair: state this current gap; either depend on the unforgeability bead or require lowering to revalidate every cost/reduction record through the checked factories and, because the invocation record carries complete cost configuration, recompute the cached total or mark it explicitly unverified. Add a mutation that inserts a Mirror-forged record rejected by AlignWire into an otherwise valid gated result and requires publication refusal. BLOCKER 2: the governing output spec requires provenance-derived ViewBasis, but the complete identity table at lines 105-115 and implementation checklist at 429-463 omit it. Raw provider/configuration receipts are not the same authority claim. Require basis derivation from admitted fixture/build/adjudication provenance, refusal for unsupported or mixed roots under the current scalar basis, and a mutation that removes or caller-asserts the basis. Scope remains the sole doc path; no Scala/API authority.
